headline: R-Type: the brains learn to leave the line
lede: The Phase-2 fortress has always telegraphed its fan — three rounds, aimed, straight once loosed. The autopilot never read it: an S1-era sign error made its bullet-crossing clock negative for every round ahead of the ship, so both brains were blind to straight fire and survived on strafe luck and kill-races. This shift marked the fan, taught pilot and wingman to slip a hand's width off the aim line without quitting the throat, and proved the winnable field got better, not just smarter-looking.

notes.text: Root fix: the lane field's crossing-time numerator was inverted since S1 — the 'leading bullets' the comments promised were never leading anything. Nine laws and two named mutants (pre-dodge-deaf, cross-blind) keep the sign honest; solo winnable 7->8 of 12 seeds, co-op 12/12, zero fortress deaths across the twelve.

PR #2955 is merge-ready (static green, 234/234, mutants 231/231) but docked behind the nightly red-main freeze; the frogger pin fix merged and a fresh nightly is running — the merge loop and prod-verify steps are parked in STATE.md for the next lane.

Ops: this PR's pull_request CI event never fired at all (not queued, not skipped — a GitHub-side miss). A workflow-dispatch produced the required static check fine; if a fresh PR shows only Vercel checks, dispatch ci.yml on the branch instead of waiting.
